definition: at the very last possible moment
description: A sunny balcony with a tiled floor, green shutters and an iron railing. A terracotta pot of red geraniums falls, and a young woman in a mustard sweater and black shorts throws herself into the splits and catches it with both hands a moment before it hits the floor, while soil sprays out onto the tiles. She bends over the pot in relief and then laughs. Behind her a young man in a white T-shirt watering flowers puts down his metal watering can, laughs and puts a hand to his head. Pots of red flowers sit on the windowsill.

taps.phrase: to put down a watering can
